proposal_text: Build a mixed-use development with a large number of new homes, ground-floor commercial space, and a smaller public plaza. Use a private development partner to begin construction quickly, while requiring local hiring and a percentage of below-market housing units.

Build a smaller mixed-use development around an accessible public plaza, green space, and a low-car transportation hub. Include affordable housing, step-free design, shaded public areas, and strong transit connections, even if the project takes longer and produces fewer total units.

Expand major roads and launch express bus routes connecting new housing areas with employment centres. Prioritize routes that support construction and business growth, and reserve land near major stops for higher-density housing.

Create a bus rapid transit network with accessible stations, dedicated lanes, lower fares, and improved pedestrian connections. Prioritize neighbourhoods with limited transportation options and design the system to reduce car use over time.
